page_title: HOF 1-3 EIN | Hoffenheim v Eintracht Frankfurt 30/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+2' A cross is whipped in towards Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) on the edge of the six-yard box. He wins the ball but sends his header just wide of the right post.

90+1' 1 - 3 What a beautiful moment! Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way inside the left post. Michael Zetterer just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 1:3.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
87' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
86' Substitution. Bernardo leaves the pitch and is replaced by Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim).
86' Eintracht Frankfurt fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
85' Eintracht Frankfurt couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Oliver Baumann (Hoffenheim) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
84' Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt) is booked.
83' Dino Toppmoller has decided to make a change. Michy Batshuayi (Eintracht Frankfurt) replaces Elye Wahi.
82' The substitution has been made. Oscar Hojlund (Eintracht Frankfurt) has replaced Rasmus Kristensen.
82' Caution goes to Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim).
81' Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) produces a good strike that sails to the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net.
78' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) is cautioned by the referee.
78' A substitution has been made. Ritsu Doan goes off and Buta (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes on.
76' A pass into the box finds Muhammed Damar (Hoffenheim) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the left side of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Michael Zetterer denies him.
75' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) latches onto a decent pass, but flashes his shot just wide of the right post.

75' That didn't go as planned. Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the left side of the goal was too weak to get past Oliver Baumann, who easily kept it out.
74' Bernardo (Hoffenheim) sends a cross into the box, but Michael Zetterer comes off his line to gather the ball.
72' Christian Ilzer prepares a substitution. Fisnik Asllani is replaced by Max Moerstedt (Hoffenheim).
72' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Robin Hranac as he is replaced by Albian Hajdari (Hoffenheim).
71' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
70' Timo Gerach blows his whistle and it's Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
68' Hoffenheim force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
67' Hoffenheim failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
67' Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
64' The corner is swung in but Eintracht Frankfurt can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

63' It will be a substitution. Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) is ready to enter the pitch as Jean-Matteo Bahoya walks off.

59' Substitution. Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) has come on for Umut Tohumcu.
58' A wild effort from Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) on the edge of the box flies well wide of the right post.
58' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Eintracht Frankfurt, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
57' Umut Tohumcu (Hoffenheim) has tested the patience of referee Timo Gerach and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

54' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Michael Zetterer pulls off a brilliant save.
51' 0 - 3 Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) collects a sweet pass and fires a shot inside the right post. What a brilliant shot!
48' Flag goes up against Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
47' Can Yilmaz Uzun (Eintracht Frankfurt) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom right corner, but Oliver Baumann easily deals with the threat.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' Timo Gerach has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
45' Booking. Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives a caution from the referee.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' The goalkeeper pulls off a great save to deny Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt), whose good effort would probably have ended inside the bottom right corner of the net.
44' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
42' Eintracht Frankfurt have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
40' A goal, which was scored by Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim), was disallowed due to offside.
36' A pass lands at the feet of Elye Wahi (Eintracht Frankfurt) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
29' Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post.
27' 0 - 2 Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives a delightful pass inside the box and smashes a precise shot inside the right post. What a lovely finish!
24' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play.
21' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
17' 0 - 1 Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) scores an absolute screamer from outside the penalty area, with the ball flying into the top left corner!
16' The resulting corner from Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

16' A beautiful low pass from the side is received by Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt), who was waiting for his chance. However, the defence is alert and spanks the ball away. Eintracht Frankfurt have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

14' That didn't go as planned! Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort low towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Michael Zetterer, who easily kept it out.
12' Great teamplay by Hoffenheim as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
5' Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) outjumps his marker and heads the resulting corner way wide of the left post.
4' Hoffenheim have been awarded a corner kick.
4' Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
2' The free kick is delivered by Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
